encode_audio_to_codes: encode raw audio waveform into discrete codes using the Mimi model
decode_codes_to_audio: decode discrete audio codes back into raw audio waveform values
run_full_encode_decode: run full encode-then-decode pipeline on raw audio to produce reconstructed audio
build_streaming_encoder: build streaming encoder with padding cache for sequential audio encoding
configure_quantizer_layers: configure residual vector quantizer layers with semantic and acoustic codebooks
